<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Pouncing Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=5508) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 79

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); your animal shape has a land Speed only

</column>

---

By transforming as you move, you attack from odd angles. You Change Shape or Dismiss the change then Stride. Any creature adjacent to you at the end of your movement is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) until the end of your turn and is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.
name: Pouncing Transformation
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a land Speed only
